subject: general
question: With which of the following countries has India jointly developed the Barak-8 missile?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Israel**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Barak 8 is a long-range surface-to-air missile developed by Israel Aerospace Industries and DRDO.
 
• Firstly, it was tested successfully in Israel on 10th November 2014.
 
• Indian Navy had successfully test-fired the missile from INS Kolkata on 29th and 30th December 2015.
 
• Recently, Israel has tested successfully Barak 8 extended-range interceptor on 22 March 2021.
 
 
• It will help in destroying a target 150 km away.​
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Features of Barak 8:

 
 
• It is also known as LR-SAM naval defence system.
 
• It will provide a 360-degree defence against various airborne threats.
 
• It will help in defending against UAVs, helicopters, aircraft, ballistic missiles, cruise missiles, etc.
 
• It can target multiple targets at the same time in all weather conditions.
 
• Initially, it had a target range of 100 km.
 
 
 
• Variants of Barak 8:
 
 
• Barak 8 AMD/LRSAM - 
 
 
• Designed for Israeli Navy.
 
• Now, used by many countries.
 
 
 
• Barak 8 MRSAM -
 
 
• It is a medium-range land-based missile system.
 
• It has a tracking radar, control system, and mobile launcher system.
 
 
 
• Barak MX -
 
 
• It has a flexible configuration option.
 
• It is useful in both naval and land missions.
